current_bottleneck: The native corporate CLI generated new orders and proofs on every restart and did not persist reserve responses or encrypted node deliveries.
causal_hypothesis: Saving the exact intent, reserve proof, admission and per-node ciphertexts in the existing encrypted crash-atomic corporate outbox, with canonical recovery at the issuer, permits repeat execution of the same request after process and node failures.
single_intended_change: Connect durable corporate submission stages and idempotent canonical reservation recovery to the existing native end-to-end path.
baseline: Published f150c86 supports one uninterrupted native pretrade/matching/settlement run but not restarted corporate submission.
most_likely_prediction_error: A recovered issuer admission or node receipt may have a new digest/generation, or a restart may regenerate an encrypted delivery rather than reuse its persisted bytes, causing the actual node to reject the retry.
rejection_rules: delivery succeeds while node 6 is stopped
any retry creates a second pretrade reserve
fresh order or ciphertexts sent after ambiguous delivery
wrong fill or native monetary proof rejection
promotion_rules: At most smoke_only; no product, performance, independent-operator or WAN promotion.
command: make remote-native-recovery-e2e REMOTE_TEST_HOST=softbank-l40s REMOTE_TEST_SSH_OPTIONS='-o BatchMode=yes -o ProxyJump=none'
